observations: Orange drilling rig mounted on a white truck chassis.
The truck has a 'Nissan Diesel' badge on the front grille.
The rig features a long mast and a drilling head assembly.
The vehicle is parked on a dirt lot with other construction equipment visible in the background.
The truck's front bumper is heavily soiled and shows signs of rust.
The rig appears to be a used, heavy-duty piece of equipment.

claims.evidence: The rig is shown in a static, dusty environment; mechanical condition cannot be confirmed from still photos.
There is no video or photo of the rig in operation.
The photos show the item in a yard, but the specific location is not confirmed.

claims.claim: Fully working, recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may be seized or have high wear.
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting and running under load.

risks.risk: The hydraulic system may leak or fail to hold weight.
risks.proof: A video showing the rig lifting a load and holding it for several minutes.

risks.risk: The drilling head or mast may be damaged or unable to rotate.
risks.proof: A video of the mast rotating and the drill bit moving.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the engine starting and running.
Video of the rig lifting a load and holding it.
Video of the mast rotating and the drill bit moving.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
